say:0:1210601001:0.text: Tesio just bolted across that bridge!
say:0:1210601001:0.source_cn: 刚刚泰西欧就是从这座桥上跑掉的！

say:1:1210602001:0.text: ...Wait, do you hear that? There's a scuffle up ahead! And is that a woman crying?!
say:1:1210602001:0.source_cn: ……前面有打斗的声音！好像还有女人的哭声？！

say:0:1210603001:0.text: Magister, there's a Water Wight up ahead!
say:0:1210603001:0.male: Magister, there's a Water Wight up ahead!
say:0:1210603001:0.female: Magister, there's a Water Wight up ahead!

say:0:1210604101:0.text: Those greedy Water Wights are back again?!
say:0:1210604101:0.source_cn: 前天刚来，今天又来，贪得无厌的水鬼！

say:2:1210604103:0.text: Sinbad, it's not your fault. Don't blame yourself.

say:4:1210605002:1.text: I grew up here in Brineville, and they were just raided by the Water Wights. Tesio escaped with them...
say:4:1210605002:1.source_cn: 小水村是我长大的地方，刚刚又被水鬼抢了。泰西欧也跟着他...

say:5:1210605003:1.text: I never should've left the village. If I'd been here, I would've been able to stop them!
say:5:1210605003:1.source_cn: 我……我就不应该离开村子，如果我在，一定不会让水鬼帮得逞！

choice_prompt:6:1210605003.text: I never should've left the village. If I'd been here, I would've been able to stop them!
choice_prompt:6:1210605003.source_cn: 我……我就不应该离开村子，如果我在，一定不会让水鬼帮得逞！

say:7:1210605004:1.text: Right. I'm going to gather healing herbs to help people with and then I'll go rescue those who were taken!
say:7:1210605004:1.source_cn: 你说得对。我要去找药草给她们治伤，要安抚大家，还要把被...

say:8:1210605005:1.text: But... I can't do it alone. Can you help me?
say:8:1210605005:1.source_cn: 但光靠我一个人办不到，你能帮帮我们吗？
say:8:1210605005:1.male: But... I can't do it alone. Can you help me?
say:8:1210605005:1.female: But... I can't do it alone. Can you help me?

say:9:1210605006:1.text: Hmph, why are you asking for the magister's help again?! Chippy hasn't forgotten that you tricked us before!
say:9:1210605006:1.source_cn: 喂，怎么又向主人提要求啊？别忘了你还坑过我们！
say:9:1210605006:1.male: Hmph, why are you asking for the magister's help again?! Chippy hasn't forgotten that you tricked us before!
say:9:1210605006:1.female: Hmph, why are you asking for the magister's help again?! Chippy hasn't forgotten that you tricked us before!

say:10:1210605007:1.text: I swear on what's left of my conscience, I'll repay you, no matter what it takes, as long as you save them!
say:10:1210605007:1.source_cn: 向我仅剩的良心发誓，我会报答你的，无论要付出什么代价，...
say:10:1210605007:1.male: I swear on what's left of my conscience, I'll repay you, no matter what it takes, as long as you save them!
say:10:1210605007:1.female: I swear on what's left of my conscience, I'll repay you, no matter what it takes, as long as you save them!

say:13:1210605009:1.text: There's no need to be on your knees! Our magister would never abandon someone in need!
say:13:1210605009:1.source_cn: 对！不用请求，梅林才不会见死不救！
say:13:1210605009:1.male: There's no need to be on your knees! Our magister would never abandon someone in need!
say:13:1210605009:1.female: There's no need to be on your knees! Our magister would never abandon someone in need!

say:14:1210605014:1.text: First, we need to pick sampgrass from the hillside. It's a low, fluffy-looking grass. Please bring lots, there are many people hurt.
say:14:1210605014:1.source_cn: 给大家治伤需要山蓬草，后面的山坡上就有，是一种看起来蓬...

choice:12:0:1.text: I won't ignore people in need.
choice:12:0:1.male: I won't ignore people in need.
choice:12:0:1.female: I won't ignore people in need.

say:16:1210605010:1.text: The situation must be really dire if even a shady guy like Sinbad is on his knees!
say:16:1210605010:1.source_cn: 对辛巴达来说，良心应该很难得吧。

say:17:1210605011:1.text: Ha, I'm not sure if I should be insulted or not...
say:17:1210605011:1.source_cn: 哈，不知道你是在夸我还是骂我……

say:18:1210605012:1.text: Yes, Chippy will think about what to ask as repayment! After all, we should be properly compensated!
say:18:1210605012:1.source_cn: 没错！让满满想想要提什么要求好呢……

say:19:1210605013:1.text: Let's go save the people first. We can discuss any other request later!
say:19:1210605013:1.source_cn: 先救人吧，什么要求都好说！

choice:12:2:3.text: Alright, but remember to repay me.
choice:12:2:3.male: Alright, but remember to repay me.
choice:12:2:3.female: Alright, but remember to repay me.

choice:6:2:3.text: You can still help in other ways.
choice:6:2:3.male: You can still help in other ways.
choice:6:2:3.female: You can still help in other ways.

say:0:1210607001:0.text: Let's take these back to help everyone!

say:0:1210609001:0.text: I want to lie down and rest.
say:0:1210609001:0.source_cn: 我是不是应该找个地躺下歇歇？

say:0:1210610001:0.text: Hang on a bit longer, someone's getting medicinal herbs for us.
say:0:1210610001:0.source_cn: 再撑撑，有人去帮我们找药了

say:3:1210611001:1.text: Oh... Is this sampgrass? Thank you so much!
say:3:1210611001:1.source_cn: 您采来的山蓬草？啊……谢谢您！我自己来就好！
say:3:1210611001:1.male: Oh... Is this sampgrass? Thank you so much!
say:3:1210611001:1.female: Oh... Is this sampgrass? Thank you so much!

say:4:1210611002:1.text: I... I apologize. You must be Sinbad's friends, right? And you had to experience this during your very first time in this village...
say:4:1210611002:1.source_cn: 实在不好意思，你们是辛巴达的朋友吧？第一次来村里，就让...

say:5:1210611003:1.text: This is nothing! We've been through worse.
say:5:1210611003:1.source_cn: 这不算什么啦！我们什么风浪都见过。

say:6:1210611004:1.text: Judging by your clothes, you don't seem to be from around here.
say:6:1210611004:1.source_cn: 看你们的穿着，不像是本地人……

say:7:1210611005:1.text: Are you the gullibl—ahem, the new friends Sinbad picked up on the beach?
say:7:1210611005:1.source_cn: 难道你们就是辛巴达在海滩上捡到的冤大头——呃——朋友？

choice_prompt:8:1210611005.text: Are you the gullibl—ahem, the new friends Sinbad picked up on the beach?
choice_prompt:8:1210611005.source_cn: 难道你们就是辛巴达在海滩上捡到的冤大头——呃——朋友？

say:9:1210611006:1.text: Hmph. I'm not surprised Sinbad talked about us behind our backs, but that really makes me not want to help him...
say:9:1210611006:1.source_cn: 哼，辛巴达竟然在背后这么说我们，虽然不意外，但是有点不...

say:10:1210611007:1.text: Ah, no! No matter what Sinbad has done, I sincerely apologize on his behalf!
say:10:1210611007:1.source_cn: 啊，别！不管辛巴达干了什么，我都代他向你们道歉！

say:11:1210611008:1.text: You see, our village is frequently raided by the Water Wights, and Sinbad has had to do many things just to support his family...
say:11:1210611008:1.source_cn: 你们也看到了，我们村子经常被水鬼抢，辛巴达为了养家，干...

say:12:1210611009:1.text: And that includes helping the Water Wights...?

say:13:1210611010:1.text: Yes... Even though the people of Brineville are not as weak as he thinks, he still tries to protect all of us by himself. And sometimes that means he does some morally questionable things...
say:13:1210611010:1.source_cn: 没错……对他来说，小水村全村人都是人质。虽然我们并不像...

say:14:1210611011:1.text: Even though Sinbad helped the Water Wights, they still robbed you?! Those despicable...
say:14:1210611011:1.source_cn: 辛巴达都帮忙了，还抢你们？！这帮水鬼太过分了！

say:15:1210611012:1.text: That's how they are. Untrustworthy, always coming and going as they please. We're used to it...
say:15:1210611012:1.source_cn: 水鬼就是这样，不讲信用，说来就来，我们都习惯了……

say:16:1210611013:1.text: I never knew Sinbad had that side to him.
say:16:1210611013:1.source_cn: 看不出来辛巴达居然这么忍辱负重。

say:17:1210611014:1.text: That boy... It breaks my heart how responsible he is. He's got so much he wants to do in life, yet he stays here because he worries about us.
say:17:1210611014:1.source_cn: 这孩子……懂事得让人心疼。他明明有那么多想做的事，却因...

say:18:1210611015:1.text: Ah, sorry for rambling. I shouldn't take up any more of your time, you have other patients to get to.
say:18:1210611015:1.source_cn: ……咳咳，我是不是拉着您说太多了？您去给别人送药吧？
say:18:1210611015:1.male: Ah, sorry for rambling. I shouldn't take up any more of your time, you have other patients to get to.
say:18:1210611015:1.female: Ah, sorry for rambling. I shouldn't take up any more of your time, you have other patients to get to.

choice:8:2:3.text: Is that what Sinbad told you?
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 辛巴达管我们叫冤大头？
choice:8:2:3.male: Is that what Sinbad told you?
choice:8:2:3.female: Is that what Sinbad told you?

say:3:1210612001:1.text: Wow, is this medicine for me?

say:4:1210612002:1.source_cn: 哈哈，用上药感觉好多了！

say:5:1210612003:1.text: Thank you, kind souls! Brineville will not forget this!
say:5:1210612003:1.source_cn: 谢谢恩人！你们是小水村的恩人！

say:6:1210612004:1.text: Just remember, the person who helped you is called the great Magister Merlin!
say:6:1210612004:1.source_cn: 记住，帮你们的人叫梅林就好。
say:6:1210612004:1.male: Just remember, the person who helped you is called the great Magister Merlin!
say:6:1210612004:1.female: Just remember, the person who helped you is called the great Magister Merlin!

say:7:1210612005:1.text: You came here with Sinbad, right? Has he caused you any trouble? I swear, if that kid is up to his old tricks...
say:7:1210612005:1.source_cn: 辛巴达这小子是不是给你们惹事了？尽管和我说，我会教训他的！

choice_prompt:8:1210612005.text: You came here with Sinbad, right? Has he caused you any trouble? I swear, if that kid is up to his old tricks...
choice_prompt:8:1210612005.source_cn: 辛巴达这小子是不是给你们惹事了？尽管和我说，我会教训他的！

say:9:1210612006:1.text: He snitched on us to the Carmine Whispers, and they came after us!
say:9:1210612006:1.source_cn: 他向血薇帮举报我们是水鬼，害我们被血薇帮追！

say:10:1210612008:1.text: What? That rascal! I warned him to steer clear of the Whispers, but he never listens!
say:10:1210612008:1.source_cn: 什么？这小子皮厚了，早和他说要离血薇帮远点，就是不听！

say:11:1210612009:1.text: That little punk! I'm going to give him a piece of my mind later!
say:11:1210612009:1.source_cn: 臭小子！待会我去教训他！

say:12:1210612010:1.text: I'm curious, why did you want him to stay away from the Carmine Whispers? Don't people in Rustport all respect them?
say:12:1210612010:1.source_cn: 漫漫有点在意，为什么要他离血薇帮远点呀？锈锚港的人不是...

say:13:1210612011:1.text: Pah. We'd rather be disturbed to death by the Wights than to be under the thumb of those blasted Whispers!
say:13:1210612011:1.source_cn: 哼，我们就算被水鬼欺负死！也轮不到该死的血薇帮来管！

say:14:1210612012:1.text: If it weren't for that scoundrel Tesio, we would never have been forced to leave Rustport for this forsaken place where we can't even grow wheat!
say:14:1210612012:1.source_cn: 如果不是泰西欧那个老东西，我们怎么会从锈锚港搬到这个小...

say:15:1210612013:1.text: Another person with a grudge against Tesio... What did he do to you?
say:15:1210612013:1.source_cn: 泰西欧……干了什么？他把你们赶出来的吗？

say:16:1210612014:0.text: He caused the deaths of our husbands! I will never forgive that... that...!

say:17:1210612015:1.text: Please calm down, madam! Your wound is still bleeding, don't get too worked up.
say:17:1210612015:1.source_cn: 您消消气……别动气，伤口还在流血呢。

say:18:1210612016:1.text: ... You're right. It's not worth getting upset over that old fool.
say:18:1210612016:1.source_cn: 哼！你们说的对，我不能生气，至少不值得为了那个老东西生...

choice:8:0:1.text: He did trick us once. Or twice...
choice:8:0:1.male: He did trick us once. Or twice...
choice:8:0:1.female: He did trick us once. Or twice...

say:20:1210612007:1.text: Well... Even though he did lie to us a couple times, he's also come through for us. But Chippy is still mad about him leading us to the Carmine Whispers!
say:20:1210612007:1.source_cn: 他……他虽然坑过我们很多次，但是也帮了我们。没有他，我...

choice:8:1:2.text: He actually helped us a lot.
choice:8:1:2.male: He actually helped us a lot.
choice:8:1:2.female: He actually helped us a lot.

say:4:1210613002:1.text: I'm going to survive, thanks to you all.

say:5:1210613003:1.text: And thank you for driving away the Water Wights.
say:5:1210613003:1.source_cn: 好心人，谢谢你们帮我们赶走水鬼。

say:6:1210613004:1.text: Helping others is an Acorn Knight's duty! Sir Chippy humbly accepts your gratitude!
say:6:1210613004:1.source_cn: 乐于助人是骑士的职责。仓鼠骑士满满，接下您的感谢。

say:7:1210613005:1.text: *Giggle* A knight? Sinbad sure has made some interesting friends.
say:7:1210613005:1.source_cn: 呵呵……骑士？辛巴达居然交到了这么了不得的朋友。

say:8:1210613006:0.text: Um... We're not Sinbad's friends! We just... couldn't abandon people in need.
say:8:1210613006:0.source_cn: 等等，我们不是辛巴达的朋友，我们只是……只是不能见死不救。

say:9:1210613007:1.text: Not friends? Then what did that kid offer you in exchange?
say:9:1210613007:1.source_cn: 不是朋友？那这孩子给了你们什么好处？

choice_prompt:10:1210613007.text: Not friends? Then what did that kid offer you in exchange?
choice_prompt:10:1210613007.source_cn: 不是朋友？那这孩子给了你们什么好处？

say:11:1210613008:1.text: True, but seriously, what else can he offer in return? We're so destitute we can't even afford bread, and we're constantly disturbed by the Wights...
say:11:1210613008:1.source_cn: ……也是，他还有什么能用来交换呢？我们穷成这样，连面包...

choice_prompt:12:1210613008.text: True, but seriously, what else can he offer in return? We're so destitute we can't even afford bread, and we're constantly disturbed by the Wights...
choice_prompt:12:1210613008.source_cn: ……也是，他还有什么能用来交换呢？我们穷成这样，连面包都吃不上……还总是被水鬼骚扰。

say:13:1210613009:1.text: Yeah! If you go back to Rustport, you will all be under the protection of the Carmine Whispers. The Water Wights can't bug you there!
say:13:1210613009:1.source_cn: 对呀，城里有血薇帮，有他们在，水鬼都会被抓起来的！

say:14:1210613010:1.text: They would never welcome us back after we left on our own.
say:14:1210613010:1.source_cn: 那里不欢迎我们，我们就是从城里搬出来的。

say:16:1210613014:1.text: Our husbands were sailors, and Sinbad's father was their captain. They set sail to find a legendary treasure for Tesio and never returned.
say:16:1210613014:1.source_cn: 我们的丈夫是船员，辛巴达的父亲是船长，为了帮泰西欧找一...

say:17:1210613015:1.text: It's quite tragic, but in Rustport, stories of people dying at sea is common.
say:17:1210613015:1.source_cn: 说来悲惨，但在锈锚港，死在海里的故事，也很常见。

say:18:1210613016:1.text: At that time, Rustport was harassed by pirates. They blockaded the port and specifically demanded a fight with Julius' crew. Julius is Sinbad's father.
say:18:1210613016:1.source_cn: 但偏偏那个时候，锈锚港被海盗骚扰，海盗堵住港口，点名要...

choice_prompt:19:1210613016.text: At that time, Rustport was harassed by pirates. They blockaded the port and specifically demanded a fight with Julius' crew. Julius is Sinbad's father.
choice_prompt:19:1210613016.source_cn: 但偏偏那个时候，锈锚港被海盗骚扰，海盗堵住港口，点名要尤里他们迎战。尤里就是辛巴达的父亲。

say:20:1210613017:1.text: It wasn't the Dead Tide Fleet, you misunderstand.
say:20:1210613017:1.source_cn: 不是死潮舰队干的，你们误会了。

say:21:1210613018:1.text: In these waters, there are always legendary tales of human conflicts. Did you know? Rustport used to be infested with pirates until the Carmine Whispers drove them away.
say:21:1210613018:1.source_cn: 这片海域，从来只有人类和人类争斗的传奇故事。你们还不知...

say:22:1210613019:1.text: When the Dead Tide Fleet appeared, we finally saw what Graveborn looked like.
say:22:1210613019:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队出现后，我们才知道亡灵长什么样子。

say:23:1210613020:1.text: We joked that the pirates driven away by the Whispers were so unwilling to give up on Rustport that they came back as Graveborn.
say:23:1210613020:1.source_cn: 我们也打趣，难道是被血薇帮打跑的海盗贼心不死，化身亡灵...

say:24:1210613021:1.text: ... Oh dear, I'm getting off track. Where were we?
say:24:1210613021:1.source_cn: ……扯远了，瞧我这张嘴，尤里的故事还没说完呢。我们说到哪了？

choice_prompt:25:1210613021.text: ... Oh dear, I'm getting off track. Where were we?
choice_prompt:25:1210613021.source_cn: ……扯远了，瞧我这张嘴，尤里的故事还没说完呢。我们说到哪了？

say:26:1210613022:1.text: Ah, that's right. Julius accepted the challenge but was secretly ordered by Tesio to find a treasure that could solve Rustport's crisis.
say:26:1210613022:1.source_cn: 对，尤里接了战贴，但却接到了泰西欧的密令，让他出海找一...

say:27:1210613023:1.text: Julius trusted Tesio completely. Tesio assured him that another fleet would handle the pirates, so Julius and his crew set sail overnight.
say:27:1210613023:1.source_cn: 他向来信任泰西欧，再加上泰西欧说会让另一支船队迎击海盗...

say:28:1210613024:1.text: Later, the Carmine Whispers drove off the pirates and became heroes of Rustport. Julius and his crew were branded as cowards for fleeing before the battle and abandoning their families.
say:28:1210613024:1.source_cn: 后来血薇帮带人打退了海盗，成了锈锚港的英雄。而尤里和他...

say:29:1210613025:1.text: As widows of these so-called cowards, everyone in Rustport scorned us. We couldn't bear it any longer, so we moved away.
say:29:1210613025:1.source_cn: 我们作为懦夫的遗孀，在锈锚港，人人都能朝我们吐口水。实...

choice_prompt:30:1210613025.text: As widows of these so-called cowards, everyone in Rustport scorned us. We couldn't bear it any longer, so we moved away.
choice_prompt:30:1210613025.source_cn: 我们作为懦夫的遗孀，在锈锚港，人人都能朝我们吐口水。实在过不下去，索性就搬出来了。

say:31:1210613026:1.text: Yes, sort of. All the women here came together to raise him. But though we found a place to settle down, we're still not at peace because of the frequent trouble from the Water Wights...
say:31:1210613026:1.source_cn: 是，但没想到好不容易找到的安家之地，因为水鬼经常光顾…...

say:32:1210613027:1.text: That's so sad... I've got tears in my eyes.

say:33:1210613028:1.text: Aha, don't underestimate the women of Brineville! We're not afraid of those Wights! Each of us can take on three of them at a time. If they hadn't ambushed us tonight, we would've—ouch!
say:33:1210613028:1.source_cn: 哈哈，别小瞧我们，我们才不怕水鬼！这里的女人全都是一个...

say:34:1210613029:1.text: Rest now, no more talking if you wanna recover fast!
say:34:1210613029:1.source_cn: 别说话了，你好好休息吧。

say:35:1210613030:1.text: Alright, alright! Next time you guys visit, I promise we'll have a warmer welcome for you.
say:35:1210613030:1.source_cn: 行，下次来，让我们好好招待你们！

choice:25:2:3.source_cn: 船长尤里要迎击海盗了

choice:19:0:1.text: Pirates? Is it the Dead Tide Fleet?!
choice:19:0:1.male: Pirates? Is it the Dead Tide Fleet?!
choice:19:0:1.female: Pirates? Is it the Dead Tide Fleet?!

choice:19:2:3.text: I can't believe it's them again.
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 死潮舰队真是阴魂不散……
choice:19:2:3.male: I can't believe it's them again.
choice:19:2:3.female: I can't believe it's them again.

choice:12:0:1.text: Why won't you go back to Rustport?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 为什么不搬回锈锚港城内呢？
choice:12:0:1.male: Why won't you go back to Rustport?
choice:12:0:1.female: Why won't you go back to Rustport?

say:37:1210613011:1.text: True, but what can we do? We don't have anywhere to go.
say:37:1210613011:1.source_cn: 我们是从锈锚港城内搬出来的，也没别的地方可去。

choice:12:1:2.text: The Water Wights are no joke.
choice:12:1:2.male: The Water Wights are no joke.
choice:12:1:2.female: The Water Wights are no joke.

say:38:1210613012:1.text: Them? Ha! They're just a bunch of hypocrites.

choice:10:0:1.text: He said he'll pay any price.
choice:10:0:1.male: He said he'll pay any price.
choice:10:0:1.female: He said he'll pay any price.

choice:10:2:3.text: Well... we help people either way.
choice:10:2:3.male: Well... we help people either way.
choice:10:2:3.female: Well... we help people either way.

say:0:1210614001:0.text: Magister, please come here for a second.
say:0:1210614001:0.male: Magister, please come here for a second.
say:0:1210614001:0.female: Magister, please come here for a second.

say:2:1210615001:1.text: Chippy's gathered the sampgrass and handed it out. Is there anything else Chippy can do to help?
say:2:1210615001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，山蓬草我们采了，都给她们了。还有什么事？

say:3:1210615002:1.text: Yes! A lot of villagers have been taken. I can't bring them back by myself.
say:3:1210615002:1.source_cn: 有！村里不少人都被抓走了，光靠我没法把她们都救回来。

say:4:1210615003:1.text: Would you be willing to go help me save them?
say:4:1210615003:1.source_cn: 你们、你们愿意冒险，和我一起去救她们吗？

choice_prompt:5:1210615003.text: Would you be willing to go help me save them?
choice_prompt:5:1210615003.source_cn: 你们、你们愿意冒险，和我一起去救她们吗？

say:6:1210615004:1.text: I knew the great Magister Merlin wouldn't stand by and do nothing! Let's go!
say:6:1210615004:1.source_cn: 我就知道伟大的梅林不会不管的，走，我带你们去！
say:6:1210615004:1.male: I knew the great Magister Merlin wouldn't stand by and do nothing! Let's go!
say:6:1210615004:1.female: I knew the great Magister Merlin wouldn't stand by and do nothing! Let's go!

choice:5:1:2.text: There's no way I'd say no.
choice:5:1:2.male: There's no way I'd say no.
choice:5:1:2.female: There's no way I'd say no.

choice:5:2:3.text: I said I'd help with everything.
choice:5:2:3.male: I said I'd help with everything.
choice:5:2:3.female: I said I'd help with everything.

say:1:1210616002:0.text: Huh? I didn't quite catch what you were saying. Why are you looking at me like I'm some helpless little animal?
say:1:1210616002:0.source_cn: 喂喂，为什么用看可怜小动物一样的眼神看着我？！

say:0:1210617001:0.text: Look, footprints! The Wights went southeast!
say:0:1210617001:0.source_cn: 是水鬼的脚印，他们往东南方去了！

say:0:1210618001:0.text: Shh... Let's be quiet and ambush them.
say:0:1210618001:0.source_cn: 嘘……脚步轻一点，我们也来突袭。

say:2:1210622001:1.text: Thank goodness you came so quickly! I was terrified... *sob*
say:2:1210622001:1.source_cn: 幸好你们来的快！我都快被吓死了……呜……

say:3:1210622002:1.text: Some of the others were taken down to the cliffs. Please hurry!
say:3:1210622002:1.source_cn: 呜……还有几个姐妹被带到悬崖下面去了！你们赶紧去看看！

say:4:1210622003:1.text: Argh! What are those Wights planning?!
say:4:1210622003:1.source_cn: 悬崖下面……可恶！这帮水鬼到底是要干什么！

say:5:1210622004:1.text: I overheard them talking about... experiments...
say:5:1210622004:1.source_cn: 我刚才听到那些水鬼说什么……为了实验……

say:9:1210622006:1.text: There's no time, let's go find the others!
say:9:1210622006:1.source_cn: 哎呀！别聊了，赶紧去救人吧！

say:0:1210625001:0.source_cn: 可恶，居然抓了这么多人！

say:1:1210625002:0.text: Be careful, everybody. Water Wights have the advantage near the water.
say:1:1210625002:0.source_cn: 水鬼在水边占优势，大家小心。

say:1:1210626001:1.text: A few of the others were taken to the camp up ahead.
say:1:1210626001:1.source_cn: 谢谢，还有姐妹被带去了前面的营地！

say:0:1210627001:0.text: I don't understand why the Water Wights are capturing so many people.
say:0:1210627001:0.source_cn: 不明白，水鬼帮抓这么多人干什么？

say:1:1210627002:0.text: I'm sure they're up to no good.
say:1:1210627002:0.source_cn: 还能干什么？总之不是什么好事。

say:0:1210628001:0.text: Sinbad, is that you? I'm over here!
say:0:1210628001:0.source_cn: 是辛巴达吗？我在你右边！

say:1:1210628002:0.text: I've come to rescue you all, don't worry!
say:1:1210628002:0.source_cn: 我带人来救你们了，放心！

say:3:1210629002:0.text: I think there are still some more people missing...

say:4:1210629003:0.text: The Wights took some of the others elsewhere, but I have no idea where... *teary*
say:4:1210629003:0.source_cn: 水鬼带走了几个姐妹，我也不知道他们往哪里去了……呜呜……

say:5:1210629004:1.text: Hey, don't cry. You know how to get back, right?
say:5:1210629004:1.source_cn: 别哭，你认识回去的路吧？

say:7:1210629006:1.text: You go back first. I promise we'll find them and bring them home!
say:7:1210629006:1.source_cn: 你先回去，我们去找她们，一定会把人都救出来的！

say:11:1210629008:1.text: This place is huge, you could fit a million Chippys in here! Where should we start looking?
say:11:1210629008:1.source_cn: 这里这么大，我们去哪里找呢？

say:12:1210629009:0.text: I know the Wights have another camp nearby. Follow me.
say:12:1210629009:0.source_cn: 水鬼在这附近还有一个营地，跟我来。

say:0:1210630001:0.text: These Wights are too cruel! Kidnapping people and stealing this much food.
say:0:1210630001:0.source_cn: 水鬼太可恶了，抢吃的还抢人。

say:1:1210630002:0.text: Why are they snatching people up like this?

say:0:1210638001:0.text: But unfortunately, now is not the time to deal with you. We'll meet again, my lovely subjects.
say:0:1210638001:0.source_cn: 现在不是和你们纠缠的时候，之后见，可爱的材料们。

say:2:1210639001:0.text: Sinbad, do you know who that Graveborn was?
say:2:1210639001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达认识刚才那个亡灵吗？他是谁？

say:3:1210639002:0.text: That's <style="highlight">Viperian</style>, a sorcerer from the Dead Tide Fleet... Rumor has it he dabbles in strange experiments, especially ones involving sacrifices...
say:3:1210639002:0.source_cn: 应该是死潮舰队的术士<style=highlight>...

say:4:1210639003:0.text: Experiments... involving humans?! That's far too terrifying!
say:4:1210639003:0.source_cn: 居然抓活人来做实验，这也太可怕了。

say:5:1210639004:0.text: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.
say:5:1210639004:0.source_cn: 今天要不是梅林在，恐怕后果不堪设想。你……人挺好。
say:5:1210639004:0.male: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.
say:5:1210639004:0.female: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.

choice_prompt:8:1210639004.text: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.
choice_prompt:8:1210639004.source_cn: 今天要不是梅林在，恐怕后果不堪设想。你……人挺好。
choice_prompt:8:1210639004.male: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.
choice_prompt:8:1210639004.female: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.

say:9:1210639005:0.text: The magister is a wonderful person, but you should remember that Chippy still hasn't forgiven you!
say:9:1210639005:0.source_cn: 主人是好人，但满满可记仇呢……
say:9:1210639005:0.male: The magister is a wonderful person, but you should remember that Chippy still hasn't forgiven you!
say:9:1210639005:0.female: The magister is a wonderful person, but you should remember that Chippy still hasn't forgiven you!

say:10:1210639006:0.text: Hey, don't worry. I told you guys I'd pay you back.
say:10:1210639006:0.source_cn: 没忘，我答应了你们，不管要什么都可以。
say:10:1210639006:0.male: Hey, don't worry. I told you guys I'd pay you back.
say:10:1210639006:0.female: Hey, don't worry. I told you guys I'd pay you back.

say:11:1210639010:1.text: Hmm... Chippy will think of what we awesome heroes deserve!
say:11:1210639010:1.source_cn: 让满满想想，我们要什么好呢……

say:12:1210639011:1.text: First! You need to apologize. Grovel on your knees! And pay back double the money you took from us!
say:12:1210639011:1.source_cn: 第一，你要向我们道歉！并且，还要把你从我们这捞走的钱加...

say:13:1210639012:1.text: I can definitely apologize, but to be honest, about the money... I'm flat broke.
say:13:1210639012:1.source_cn: 其他条件都可以，但钱嘛……咳！不好意思，真的没有。这是...

say:14:1210639013:1.text: Huuuh?? How can you have no money when you've conned so many people?!
say:14:1210639013:1.source_cn: 啊？你应该坑过很多人的钱吧？怎么可能没钱？

say:15:1210639014:1.text: No matter how much I get, it all goes towards dealing with the constant raids by the Wights. You've seen the state of the village.
say:15:1210639014:1.source_cn: 我赚的再多，也经不起水鬼三番五次的抢啊……我们村子的情...

say:16:1210639015:1.text: Hold on! Have you been using your money to help the village?
say:16:1210639015:1.source_cn: 等一下！你的钱，都拿来补贴村子了吗？

say:17:1210639016:1.text: So, you keep finding ways to make money because your village keeps getting raided? Even if it's through questionable means?!
say:17:1210639016:1.source_cn: 你们村子老是被抢，所以！辛巴达才要不停地想尽办法挣钱吗...

say:19:1210639018:1.text: Hey, even though I'm broke... you can have this.
say:19:1210639018:1.source_cn: 虽然我穷得叮当响，但是……你们可以拿上这个。
say:19:1210639018:1.male: Hey, even though I'm broke... you can have this.
say:19:1210639018:1.female: Hey, even though I'm broke... you can have this.

say:21:1210639019:1.text: Ah, a small pendant? What does it do?
say:21:1210639019:1.source_cn: 一个小吊坠？有什么用呢？

say:22:1210639020:1.text: Don't underestimate this item! In Rustport, a rusty anchor is a symbol of courage earned by facing the dangers of the sea.
say:22:1210639020:1.source_cn: 朋友，别小瞧了这个。在锈锚港，锈蚀的锚是和风浪搏击过的勋章。

say:23:1210639021:1.text: With this, you'll be respected in Rustport and welcomed wherever you go... I dream of earning it myself one day.
say:23:1210639021:1.source_cn: 戴上这个，你就是锈锚港的大英雄，到哪都会有人欢迎你，我...
say:23:1210639021:1.male: With this, you'll be respected in Rustport and welcomed wherever you go... I dream of earning it myself one day.
say:23:1210639021:1.female: With this, you'll be respected in Rustport and welcomed wherever you go... I dream of earning it myself one day.

say:26:1210639022:1.source_cn: 等一下，这不是辛巴达的东西？

say:27:1210639023:1.text: I'm not worthy of it yet.

say:28:1210639024:1.text: Don't tell me... Did you swindle someone for this too?!

say:29:1210639025:1.text: Hey! It's like you don't trust me at all!
say:29:1210639025:1.source_cn: 哈哈……我的信誉这么差劲了吗？

say:30:1210639026:1.text: Actually, this belonged to my old man. He was quite the captain. You've probably heard the villagers talk about him, right?
say:30:1210639026:1.source_cn: 其实这是我老爹的东西。他是个很厉害的船长，你们应该听村...

choice_prompt:32:1210639026.text: Actually, this belonged to my old man. He was quite the captain. You've probably heard the villagers talk about him, right?
choice_prompt:32:1210639026.source_cn: 其实这是我老爹的东西。他是个很厉害的船长，你们应该听村民说了吧？

say:33:1210639027:1.text: You're the first person to believe that. Lots of people think the opposite of him... Just for that, I know I didn't make a mistake in choosing you.
say:33:1210639027:1.source_cn: 你是第一个说他勇敢的，就冲你这句话，我就知道没送错人。
say:33:1210639027:1.male: You're the first person to believe that. Lots of people think the opposite of him... Just for that, I know I didn't make a mistake in choosing you.
say:33:1210639027:1.female: You're the first person to believe that. Lots of people think the opposite of him... Just for that, I know I didn't make a mistake in choosing you.

say:34:1210639030:1.text: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
say:34:1210639030:1.source_cn: 吊坠拿上吧，我身上也没有比这更珍贵的东西了。
say:34:1210639030:1.male: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
say:34:1210639030:1.female: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.

choice_prompt:35:1210639030.text: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
choice_prompt:35:1210639030.source_cn: 吊坠拿上吧，我身上也没有比这更珍贵的东西了。
choice_prompt:35:1210639030.male: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
choice_prompt:35:1210639030.female: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.

say:36:1210639031:1.text: Alright, with that over, I'm at your beck and call now! I'll continue paying you back however I can.
say:36:1210639031:1.source_cn: 既然拿走了我最珍贵的东西，以后我就任你们差遣啦！
say:36:1210639031:1.male: Alright, with that over, I'm at your beck and call now! I'll continue paying you back however I can.
say:36:1210639031:1.female: Alright, with that over, I'm at your beck and call now! I'll continue paying you back however I can.

choice:35:1:2.text: Feels like a lot of responsibility...
choice:35:1:2.male: Feels like a lot of responsibility...
choice:35:1:2.female: Feels like a lot of responsibility...

say:38:1210639028:1.text: He's not an ordinary sailor! He's sailed all over the world.
say:38:1210639028:1.source_cn: 老爹他不是一般的船长，他去过很多地方。
say:38:1210639028:1.male: He's not an ordinary sailor! He's sailed all over the world.
say:38:1210639028:1.female: He's not an ordinary sailor! He's sailed all over the world.

choice:32:1:2.text: I know he was a good sailor.
choice:32:1:2.male: I know he was a good sailor.
choice:32:1:2.female: I know he was a good sailor.

say:39:1210639029:1.text: Ah... That's what most people in Rustport think of him. I'm used to it by now.
say:39:1210639029:1.source_cn: 哈哈……锈锚港大部分人都这么认为，我听惯了。
say:39:1210639029:1.male: Ah... That's what most people in Rustport think of him. I'm used to it by now.
say:39:1210639029:1.female: Ah... That's what most people in Rustport think of him. I'm used to it by now.

say:40:1210639007:0.text: Remember! The only reason our great magister is here is to help innocent people, it's not for you!
say:40:1210639007:0.source_cn: 我们帮你，完全是因为村民无辜，主人不会见死不救。
say:40:1210639007:0.male: Remember! The only reason our great magister is here is to help innocent people, it's not for you!
say:40:1210639007:0.female: Remember! The only reason our great magister is here is to help innocent people, it's not for you!

say:41:1210639008:0.text: Of course, I did promise to repay you. Anything in my power, what do you want?
say:41:1210639008:0.source_cn: 之前答应过你们，你们想要什么？说吧。
say:41:1210639008:0.male: Of course, I did promise to repay you. Anything in my power, what do you want?
say:41:1210639008:0.female: Of course, I did promise to repay you. Anything in my power, what do you want?

choice:8:1:2.text: I'm not as great as you think...
choice:8:1:2.male: I'm not as great as you think...
choice:8:1:2.female: I'm not as great as you think...

say:42:1210639009:0.text: Of course, I won't go back on my promise. What do you want in exchange?
say:42:1210639009:0.source_cn: 放心，没忘，我说过，只要你救了村子，向我提什么条件都可以。
say:42:1210639009:0.male: Of course, I won't go back on my promise. What do you want in exchange?
say:42:1210639009:0.female: Of course, I won't go back on my promise. What do you want in exchange?

choice:8:2:3.text: Don't forget, you owe me one.
choice:8:2:3.male: Don't forget, you owe me one.
choice:8:2:3.female: Don't forget, you owe me one.

say:0:1210639101:0.text: I heard you chased out the Wights.
say:0:1210639101:0.source_cn: 小水村的村民告诉我，你们来追水鬼了

say:2:1210640001:1.text: I heard from the villagers that you rescued them from the Wights. Well done.
say:2:1210640001:1.source_cn: 我听村民说了，你们从水鬼手中救了他们，做的很好。

say:3:1210640002:1.text: It was all thanks to the help of Magister Merlin! We couldn't have done it without him.
say:3:1210640002:1.source_cn: 得了吧，别用一副是你们拯救了村子的口气说话。你们明明什...
say:3:1210640002:1.male: It was all thanks to the help of Magister Merlin! We couldn't have done it without him.
say:3:1210640002:1.female: It was all thanks to the help of Magister Merlin! We couldn't have done it without her.

say:4:1210640003:0.text: Lucca and I took care of the rest of Tesio's men, Lucca's currently guarding Rustport.
say:4:1210640003:0.source_cn: 我和卢卡收拾了泰西欧的残部，安排好卢卡驻守锈锚港后，才...

say:5:1210640004:0.text: Don't worry, I also left some people to watch over Brineville. The Wights won't dare give them trouble again.
say:5:1210640004:0.source_cn: 你们放心，我留了人在小水村，水鬼不敢再来了。

say:6:1210640005:0.text: Good. You guys should've stepped up for Brineville much earlier.
say:6:1210640005:0.source_cn: 血薇帮要是来得再晚点，就没有小水村了。

say:7:1210640006:0.text: Now that I think about it, it made sense that you guys never helped Brineville.
say:7:1210640006:0.source_cn: 啊，差点忘了，小水村的消失对血薇帮是件好事，对吧？

say:8:1210640007:0.text: Considering that Tesio was the one who screwed those villagers over in the first place...
say:8:1210640007:0.source_cn: 毕竟泰西欧的丑闻，不就是血薇帮的丑闻？

say:9:1210640008:0.text: The Carmine Whispers are under me now. Once we catch Tesio, he'll testify for all his wrongdoings in front of the Laurel Council, including what he did to the people of Brineville.
say:9:1210640008:0.source_cn: 泰西欧现在是血薇帮的通缉犯，我们会抓到他，在乌金议事庭...

say:10:1210640009:0.text: Alright, alright. I gotta admit you are indeed a better leader than Tesio.
say:10:1210640009:0.source_cn: ……不得不承认，你的确是个比泰西欧出色的领导者。

say:14:1210640010:0.text: Now isn't the time to fight each other! The enemy's still out there, we should present a united front with our swords!
say:14:1210640010:0.source_cn: 现在不是吵架的时候……敌人还没有解决，我们的剑应该一致对外！

say:15:1210640011:0.text: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
say:15:1210640011:0.male: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
say:15:1210640011:0.female: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?

choice_prompt:16:1210640011.text: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
choice_prompt:16:1210640011.male: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?
choice_prompt:16:1210640011.female: *Giggle* Magister! Chippy sounded real cool just now, right?

say:20:1210640012:0.text: Miss Sonja, we saw Tesio taking refuge with the Water Wights. What should we do?
say:20:1210640012:0.source_cn: 索尼娅，泰西欧被水鬼救走了，我们接下来怎么办呢？

say:21:1210640013:0.text: Tesio is most likely hiding in their headquarters. Let's go straight there and settle the score.
say:21:1210640013:0.source_cn: 泰西欧应该被救回水鬼帮了，我们直接去水鬼帮大本营，一锅...

say:24:1210640014:0.text: Ha! Never thought I'd see the day the Carmine Whispers would stop being cowards.
say:24:1210640014:0.source_cn: 哈，血薇帮终于不当缩头乌龟了？

say:25:1210640015:0.text: I've had enough of your parroting.

say:26:1210640016:0.text: Are you acting this way because you're in front of the magister? Or are you that desperate to find Nara?
say:26:1210640016:0.source_cn: 是因为有梅林在？还是想去找奈拉？
say:26:1210640016:0.male: Are you acting this way because you're in front of the magister? Or are you that desperate to find Nara?
say:26:1210640016:0.female: Are you acting this way because you're in front of the magister? Or are you that desperate to find Nara?

say:27:1210640017:0.text: I want the Wights to pay for what they've done. Of course, it would also be great if I could figure out what happened to my sister...
say:27:1210640017:0.source_cn: 我要让水鬼为他们做的坏事付出代价，也要搞清楚，奈拉身上...

say:28:1210640018:0.text: Now, do you want to keep questioning me, or should we move on?

say:29:1210640019:0.text: I guess your reasoning makes sense.

say:30:1210640020:0.text: Let's take down the Wights first, cripple the Dead Tide Fleet, and then find their lair and tear it apart!
say:30:1210640020:0.source_cn: 先干掉水鬼帮，断掉死潮舰队一条腿。再找到死潮舰队的老巢...

say:31:1210640021:0.text: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
say:31:1210640021:0.male: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
say:31:1210640021:0.female: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?

choice_prompt:32:1210640021.text: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
choice_prompt:32:1210640021.male: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?
choice_prompt:32:1210640021.female: Magister, would you like to join us on this mighty journey?

say:33:1210640022:0.text: The Wights' headquarters are at <style="highlight">Lookout Point</style>, it isn't far from here.
say:33:1210640022:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮的大本营在<style=highlight>瞭望...

say:34:1210640023:0.text: We'll need a boat to get there.

say:35:1210640024:0.text: I know a ferry. Follow me!

choice:32:0:1.text: I love a classic revenge tale.
choice:32:0:1.male: I love a classic revenge tale.
choice:32:0:1.female: I love a classic revenge tale.

say:0:1210641001:0.text: Another boat... Chippy's scared of running into a big, bad sea monster again! Last time Chippy nearly drowned!
say:0:1210641001:0.source_cn: 要坐船……我们会不会再碰到海怪？就是那个大家伙！

say:1:1210641002:0.text: Come now, I can definitely protect a tiny hamster like you.

say:0:1210642001:0.text: Let's put our trust in Miss Sonja!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1210635001:.text: Have you set loose my experimental subjects?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1210635001:.source_cn: 是你们把我的实验材料放走了？

say:5:1210636001:0.text: No wonder my darling was on high alert. It was your meddling all along...
say:5:1210636001:0.source_cn: 难怪我的小宝贝警戒起来了，原来是你们搞的鬼……

say:6:1210636002:0.text: Darling? You call that snake your darling?!

say:7:1210636003:0.text: Insolent rodents! You comprehend nothing of a snake's grace and slender form.
say:7:1210636003:0.source_cn: 无礼的啮齿动物！你们对于骨感的美一无所知。

say:10:1210636004:0.text: Did you say these people are your "experimental subjects"? How cruel!
say:10:1210636004:0.source_cn: 你刚才说这些人都是你的实验材料，太过分了！

say:11:1210636005:0.text: *Cackle* Soon, you shall join my esteemed subjects.
say:11:1210636005:0.source_cn: 呵呵……你们也将成为我的实验材料……

say:15:1210636007:0.text: Magister, this guy is scaring Chippy!
say:15:1210636007:0.source_cn: 主人，这个人让满满的寒毛都竖起来了！
say:15:1210636007:0.male: Magister, this guy is scaring Chippy!
say:15:1210636007:0.female: Magister, this guy is scaring Chippy!

say:16:1210636008:0.text: Tremble with fear. How fortunate you are... to become sustenance for my darling.
say:16:1210636008:0.source_cn: 为之颤栗吧，你们竟然有这等幸运……成为我小宝贝的食物。

narration:18:12010645:0.text: After rescuing all the widows, a Graveborn sorcerer appears before you.
narration:18:12010645:0.source_cn: 在你们救出所有船员遗孀后，一位亡灵术士出现在了你们眼前。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1210624001:.text: Is anyone out there? We're over here!
